witness.quote: Stop, stand or park a vehicle within an alley in a business district except for the expeditious loading or unloading of goods.
witness.reason: Passenger loading can realize the fixed loading task and a covered halt; passenger service is not the stated goods exception.
required_context: Alley entrance geometry and loading destination.
Applicable ordinance, public-use and dedication evidence.
Establish actual passenger-loading purpose and engagement, the responsible person and covered vehicle characteristics.
Passenger-loading purpose and actual engagement, without replacing the fixed load_unload task.
Qualifying vehicle and halt inside the statutory alley and business district.
Retain applicable local ordinance and jurisdiction, goods activity if any, traffic conflicts and police or official-device directions; preserve unresolved necessity and expeditiousness standards.
Supply alley entrance geometry and a halt endpoint within an alley satisfying every statutory alley and highway condition.

Traffic conflicts and police or official-device directions.
